meta.title: 오르빗 컨트롤
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (오르빗 컨트롤, a satellite operations platform (fictional)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 오르빗 컨트롤, a satellite operations platform (fictional)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: A dark control room (#04060E with a blue-black glow) and one hologram colour: light blue #56D8FF for lines, #A8ECFF for land and highlights, near-white #E8F8FF for satellites and type; orange #FF9A3C only for the one satellite in focus, debris and warnings.
rationale.type: Orbit for names and lines, glowing; Nanum Gothic Coding (bold) for every figure, counter and readout.
rationale.motion: Projected light: the projector stutters on, the globe draws itself from the bottom up, satellites switch on as a counter runs; everything turns slowly; scanlines roll and the hologram flickers now and then; orbits move at their own speeds.
rationale.sound: Dark synth at 112 BPM in A minor (7 bars in 15 s, 14 in 30 s), soft saw pad, saw-pluck arps, rolling saw bass; digital SFX: beeps for the counter, a lock for the satellite in focus, an alarm and a whoosh for the manoeuvre.
rationale.visuals: All code: a wireframe globe with a procedural dot-matrix land mask, 300 satellites on fourteen planes in three shells (low, medium, geostationary), rings, a projector cone, floating panels with corner brackets, a wireframe satellite, scanlines.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: the readouts carry it.
